access.definition: Login, signup, password or account access

subtopics.login_failure: Cannot log in / logged out / login loop / login errors
subtopics.account_hacked: Account taken over, email changed, unknown devices or activity
subtopics.signup: Cannot create an account or verify email/phone
subtopics.account_management: Password reset, linked accounts (Facebook/Google), deleting or recovering an account

usability.definition: Navigation, controls, layout, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions

subtopics.ads: Ad frequency, length, loudness, ads interrupting listening
subtopics.ui_redesign: Disliked update / new layout / removed familiar UI element
subtopics.navigation_controls: Hard to find things, buttons, gestures, widgets, notifications, settings
subtopics.shuffle_autoplay: Shuffle or autoplay behaviour that is not described as premium-only

playback.definition: Playback failure, crashes, lag, connection failures, audio quality, resource use

subtopics.crash_wont_open: App crashes, freezes, won't open, black/blank screen
subtopics.stops_skips: Music stops, pauses, skips or won't start playing
subtopics.lag_slow: Lag, slow loading, buffering, laggy UI
subtopics.connection_error: No internet / offline errors while online, connection failures
subtopics.device_integration: Bluetooth, car, Android Auto, Chromecast, smartwatch, Connect
subtopics.battery_resources: Battery drain, storage, data or memory use

downloads.definition: Downloading, saved music, offline listening, disappearing downloads

subtopics.cannot_download: Download fails, stuck, or download option missing

catalog.definition: Missing songs/artists, search/discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability

subtopics.missing_content: Songs, artists, albums or regions missing or removed; content policy/censorship
subtopics.lyrics: Lyrics missing, wrong or out of sync (lyrics behind a paywall is billing)
subtopics.podcasts_audiobooks: Podcast or audiobook content and features

billing.definition: Price, charges, subscriptions, paywalls, premium entitlement; explicitly premium-only controls go here

subtopics.free_tier_limits: Skip limits, shuffle-only, can't choose songs, features moved behind premium
subtopics.price: Price too high or price increase
subtopics.unwanted_charge: Charged unexpectedly, double charge, charged after cancelling, refund
subtopics.premium_not_working: Paid but premium not active, family/student plan problems

support.definition: Contacting support and the support response

subtopics.no_response: Cannot reach support or no reply
subtopics.unhelpful: Support replied but did not help

other.definition: General praise/criticism, unrelated content, or no supported specific topic

subtopics.general: General praise or general criticism with no specific feature
subtopics.unrelated: Unrelated, political/boycott slogans, meaningless or unsupported-language text

severity.1: No reported problem: praise, neutral/unclear content, or a pure feature request
severity.2: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance, or a cosmetic issue; no supported functional loss
severity.3: A degraded or restricted function; some use or workaround remains
severity.4: A clearly blocked core task, such as inability to log in or play music
severity.5: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm
